blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The government is lining up nine airports and three major railway projects for public-private partnership (PPP) arrangements before President Marcos ends his term in June 2028, Transportation Secretary Vince Dizon said Friday. Dizon announced the plans during the 11th Pilipinas Conference organized by think tank Stratbase Institute, where he outlined the administration’s efforts to complete delayed infrastructure projects and improve the country’s transportation system. READ: PPP projects rack up P2.81-trillion pipeline He said Mr. Marcos had directed him to “shake it up some more,” particularly in addressing the daily struggles of commuters.
